assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Atherosclerotic heart disease is coded as I25.10.
Nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency is coded as I34.0.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered with CPT code 93229.
The service is ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying arrhythmias and to guide further management of the unspecified cardiac rhythm disturbance.
Unspecified cardiac rhythm disturbance is coded as I49.9.
The denial was based on Reason Code CO-197.
